# Definition of Done

This agreement covers these repositories in this Factory workspace:
- team/app

Feature-specific plan acceptance criteria must also be met.
Independent review, required repository/PR checks and confirmed merge are required.
Foreman checks the PR, actual merge commit, review and exact-final-revision check
results before completing the plan after the feature-owner handoff.
Deployment to staging through Delivery is required. Foreman verifies
successful stages and revision evidence for the actual merged revision in each
affected repository. Record workflow run/attempt and artifact links in tasks.
Missing, failed, skipped, pending or inconclusive required evidence blocks
completion. Keep the plan open and raise or reuse a linked follow-up issue.
Deployed E2E must pass after deployment succeeds, against this isolated
environment, not just a checkout server. Record run/attempt and artifact
links identifying the actual deployed repository combination tested.
